name: 乔治·佩吉特·汤姆孙
bio_short: 英国物理学家, 1937年诺贝尔物理学奖得主. 他通过电子衍射实验 (`gp_thomson_diffraction_1927`) 证实了德布罗意的物质波假说. 著名的科学趣闻是: 他的父亲 (J.J. 汤姆孙) 证明了电子是粒子, 而他证明了电子是波.
bio_short_en: A British physicist and 1937 Nobel laureate. He confirmed de Broglie's matter wave hypothesis through electron diffraction experiments (`gp_thomson_diffraction_1927`). He is famous for the historical irony that his father (J.J. Thomson) proved the electron was a particle, while he proved it was a wave.
